title: If I had to start day trading from zero, I’d build discipline before I touched indicators 🎯
author: TradeCoach_
selftext:
If I lost everything and had to start day trading from scratch, I wouldn’t start with fancy setups or 10 indicators.

I’d start with:  
•	simple charts (TradingView) 📊  
•	a clean broker (Webull) 📱  
•	and a system that keeps me disciplined everyday 💪

That’s why I built TradeCoach.

It’s an AI trading coach that:  
•	tracks the trades you actually take 🧾  
•	scores how well you followed your rules ✅❌  
•	shows you where emotion is creeping in 😵

Most beginners think they need more tools.    
I think they need more discipline.

If you were starting from zero today, what would you focus on first? 👀
